name: @red-cup-engineering/stripe-services-section
description: A sovereign emsenn-owned Stripe Checkout and verified-event boundary with fixed offerings, idempotency, and provider-local receipts. Owns the Stripe business logic and credentials; the inbound HTTP listener that fronts it is stripe-webhook-receiver-activation in rsc-quiescent.

scripts.check: node --check src/law.mjs && node --check src/service.mjs && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check test/service.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: an ActivityStreams solicitation for one configured offering, followed by acceptance of the provider-authored request digest, or a Stripe webhook whose signature verifies over the untouched body
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unknown or non-live offering, arbitrary caller-supplied price, credential absence, credential/mode mismatch, invalid redirect URL, fabricated provider offer, invalid or stale webhook signature, cross-settlement write, refund, payout, or entitlement mutation
